entry.title: Azure/azure-sdk-for-net - Releases - 2026-08-03
entry.content:
Azure.ResourceManager.ContainerRegistry_1.5.0-beta.3

1.5.0-beta.3 (2026-08-07)

Features Added

  • Updated API version to 2026-03-01-preview.

Other Changes

  • Migrated from AutoRest/Swagger to TypeSpec-based generation.
  • Added support for Archive and ArchiveVersion resources.
  • Added support for ExportPipeline, ImportPipeline and PipelineRun resources.
  • Added missing [Obsolete] attribute to ContainerRegistryAgentPoolPatch for consistency with other deprecated RegistryTasks types.

Azure.ResourceManager.Compute.BulkActions_1.2.0-beta.1

1.2.0-beta.1 (2026-08-03)

Features Added

  • The ExecuteStartContent, ExecuteDeallocateContent, ExecuteHibernateContent, and ExecuteDeleteContent models now expose a settable Resources property and a constructor overload that accepts only executionParameters, in addition to the existing (executionParameters, resources) constructor.
